organs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Transform this kidney image into a DELIGHTFUL CUTE GEOMETRIC MOBILE-GAME BATTLEFIELD, like a handcrafted pastel board-game arena. The user dislikes clinical gross biological details. Preserve EXACT kidney exterior bean silhouette and its concave side notch, original orientation and transparent framing. MANDATORY TERRAIN DEPTH: the WHOLE interior must read as a SHALLOW SUNKEN BOWL / concave battlefield, with a raised warm-peach perimeter rim, an inner cream bevel, 2-3 broad descending softly faceted terraces and a spacious flat recessed rose floor at the bottom. Use top-down orthographic game-map view, keep the same projected exterior outline; depth comes from crisp cel-shaded inner rim, slope facets and a soft inner cast shadow, not tilting the organ. At least 65% of the inner basin must be clear connected navigable space. Kidney-specific cover: only 3-5 small playful rounded triangular renal-pyramid platform blocks and 2-3 compact flower-shaped renal-cell islands, each made of 3-5 CLOSED solid rounded polygon petals, with a simple circular center. These are pastel toy blocks, not realistic tissue. Arrange a couple of these as a low D-shaped/crescent barrier, with a free center opening and walkable gaps. Smooth matte apricot, coral, rose and warm ivory, short clean outlines, controlled two/three-tone cel shading, polished cute anime geometry. DELETE all old long pink/red/blue/purple pipe loops and every thin C/D marker. No worm shapes, no tentacles, no coils, no strings, no hollow donuts, no pores, no teeth, no slime, no wet or realistic flesh, no glistening beads, no faces/eyes/text/icons/characters. Output transparent background, same exact framing. The result should look like a friendly playable miniature terrain bowl with charming geometric islands. The hilum notch must stay on the RIGHT side as in this reference.
